blocks.text: On entering the Synagogue:
וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבֹא בֵיתֶךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל קָדְשְׁךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶךָ׃ בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים נְהַלֵּךְ בְּרָגֶשׁ׃

מַה־טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃ וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבֹא בֵיתֶךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל קָדְשְׁךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶךָ׃ יְיָ אָהַבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶךָ וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃ וַאֲנִי אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְאֶכְרָעָה אֶבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי־יְיָ עֹשִׂי׃ וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי־לְךָ יְיָ עֵת רָצוֹן אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּךָ עֲנֵנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶךָ׃

אֲנִי קְרָאתִיךָ כִי־תַעֲנֵנִי אֵל הַט־אָזְנְךָ לִי שְׁמַע אִמְרָתִי׃ אֲנִי בְּצֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶה פָנֶיךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָה בְהָקִיץ תְּמוּנָתֶךָ׃ וַאֲנִי עָלֶיךָ בָטַחְתִּי יְיָ אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהַי אָתָּה׃ שְׁמַע קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִי אֵלֶיךָ בְּנָשְׂאִי יָדַי אֶל־דְּבִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ׃ יְיָ אֱלֹהָי שִׁוַּעְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ וַתִּרְפָּאֵנִי׃ אֵלֶיךָ יְיָ אֶקְרָא וְאֶל־אֲדֹנָי אֶתְחַנָּן׃ הָאִירָה פָנֶיךָ עַל־עַבְדֶּךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי בְחַסְדֶּךָ׃ כִּי־לְךָ יְיָ הוֹחָלְתִּי אַתָּה תַעֲנֶה אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהָי׃ שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי יְיָ וְשַׁוְעָתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֶל־דִּמְעָתִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ׃ שְׁמַע־יְיָ וְחָנֵּנִי יְיָ הֱיֵה עֹזֵר לִי׃

שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד שָׂמַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִים לִי בֵּית יְיָ נֵלֵךְ׃ שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִי עַל־אִמְרָתֶךָ כְּמוֹצֵא שָׁלָל רָב׃ הַקְשִׁיבָה לְקוֹל שַׁוְעִי מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָי כִּי־אֵלֶיךָ אֶתְפַּלָּל׃ יְיָ בֹּקֶר תִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי בֹּקֶר אֶעֱרָךְ־לְךָ וַאֲצַפֶּה׃ אֲנִי קְרָאתִיךָ כִי־תַעֲנֵנִי אֵל הַט־אָזְנְךָ לִי שְׁמַע אִמְרָתִי׃ רַגְלִי עָמְדָה בְמִישׁוֹר בְּמַקְהֵלִים אֲבָרֵךְ יְיָ׃

blocks.text: [right column] פֿאָרבעטער:
[right column] בָּרְכוּ אֶת־יְיָ הַמְבֹרָךְ׃
[right column, small] קו״ח
[right column] בָּרוּךְ יְיָ הַמְבֹרָךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃

[right column, continuing below at full width] בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בִּדְבָרוֹ מַעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים בְּחָכְמָה פֹּתֵחַ שְׁעָרִים בִּתְבוּנָה מְשַׁנֶּה עִתִּים וּמַחֲלִיף אֶת־
[left column] געמיינדע:

[left column] יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא שְׁמוֹ שֶׁל מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שֶׁהוּא רִאשׁוֹן וְהוּא אַחֲרוֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדָיו אֵין אֱלֹהִים סֹלּוּ לָרֹכֵב בָּעֲרָבוֹת בְּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ וְעִלְזוּ לְפָנָיו. וּשְׁמוֹ מְרוֹמָם עַל־כָּל־בְּרָכָה וּתְהִלָּה׃ בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃ יְהִי שֵׁם יְיָ מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם׃

[full width, continues right column] הַזְּמַנִּים וּמְסַדֵּר אֶת־הַכֹּכָבִים בְּמִשְׁמְרֹתֵיהֶם בָּרָקִיעַ כִּרְצוֹנוֹ בּוֹרֵא יוֹם וָלָיְלָה גּוֹלֵל אוֹר מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ וְחֹשֶׁךְ מִפְּנֵי־אוֹר. וּמַעֲבִיר יוֹם וּמֵבִיא לָיְלָה וּמַבְדִּיל בֵּין יוֹם וּבֵין לָיְלָה יְיָ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ. אֵל חַי וְקַיָּם תָּמִיד יִמְלוֹךְ עָלֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמַּעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים׃

אַהֲבַת עוֹלָם בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמְּךָ אָהָבְתָּ, תּוֹרָה וּמִצְוֹת חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים אוֹתָנוּ לִמַּדְתָּ, עַל־כֵּן יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּשָׁכְבֵנוּ וּבְקוּמֵנוּ נָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ, וְנִשְׂמַח בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, כִּי הֵם חַיֵּינוּ וְאֹרֶךְ יָמֵינוּ וּבָהֶם נֶהְגֶּה יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה. וְאַהֲבָתְךָ אַל־תָּסִיר מִמֶּנּוּ לְעוֹלָמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אוֹהֵב עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

independent.heading: Evening Prayer for the New Year

blocks.text: [left column] Reader:
[left column] ברכו Bless the Lord, who is called blessed.
[left column] Congregation:
[left column] Blessed is the Lord who is called blessed for ever and ever.

[left column, continues full width below] Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who by His word brings on the evening, opens the gates in wisdom, changes the times with understanding, alters
[right column] Congregation:

[right column] Blessed and praised, glorified, exalted and extolled be the Name of the Supreme King of Kings, the Holy One blessed be He. He is the first and He is the last and beside Him there is no God. Make way before Him, who is enthroned above the clouds, Yah is his Name and rejoice before Him, His Name is exalted above all blessing and fame. Blessed be His glorious royal Name for ever and ever.

the periods and orders the stars in their watches in the sky according to His will. He creates day and night, causes light to give way to darkness and darkness to light, leads away the day and brings on the night and distinguishes between day and night. The Lord of Hosts is His Name. The living and eternal God will constantly reign over us for ever and ever. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who brings on evenings.

אהבת With eternal love dost Thou love Thy people, the House of Israel. Torah, commandments, statutes and judgments hast Thou taught us. Therefore, O Lord our God, when we lie down and when we arise, we will speak of Thy statutes. We rejoice in the words of Thy Torah and in Thy commandments for ever and ever, for they are our life and the length of our days and on them will we meditate day and night. Let not Thy love depart from us for all eternity. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who loves His people Israel.
(Deut. VI. 4)

independent.heading: מַעֲרִיב לֵיל שֵׁנִי שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה

blocks.text: לְבָבֶֽךָ׃ וְשִׁנַּנְתָּ֣ם לְבָנֶ֔יךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֖ בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃ וּקְשַׁרְתָּ֥ם לְא֖וֹת עַל־יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהָי֥וּ לְטֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽיךָ׃ וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזֻז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
דברים י״א י״ג

וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ וּלְעָבְד֔וֹ בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃ וְנָתַתִּ֧י מְטַֽר־אַרְצְכֶ֛ם בְּעִתּ֖וֹ יוֹרֶ֣ה וּמַלְק֑וֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔ךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ֖ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ׃ וְנָתַתִּ֛י עֵ֥שֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ֖ לִבְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃ הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥ן־יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְסַרְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃ וְחָרָ֨ה אַף־יְהוָ֜ה בָּכֶ֗ם וְעָצַ֤ר אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְהָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן אֶת־יְבוּלָ֑הּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃ וְשַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרַ֣י אֵ֔לֶּה עַל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וְעַֽל־נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤ם לְאוֹת֙ עַל־יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶֽם׃ וְלִמַּדְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֛ם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְדַבֵּ֣ר בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃ וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזוּז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃ לְמַ֨עַן יִרְבּ֤וּ יְמֵיכֶם֙ וִימֵ֣י בְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם כִּימֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
במדבר ט״ו ל״ז

blocks.text: speak of them when you sit in your house and when you walk on the way, when you lie down and when you rise up. You shall bind them for a sign upon your arm and they shall be frontlets between your eyes. You shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates.

(Deut. XI. 13) And it shall happen if you listen carefully to My commandments which I command you today, to love the Lord your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul, that I will grant the rain of your land in its season, the former rain and the latter rain, so that you will gather in your corn, your wine and your oil. I will give grass to your field for your cattle, and you shall eat and be satisfied. Take care that your heart be not deceived and that you do not turn aside and serve strange gods and bow down before them. For then the wrath of the Lord will burn against you and He will close the heavens so that no rain shall fall and the earth shall not yield its produce, and you shall soon perish from the good land that the Lord is giving you. Lay these words of mine upon your heart and upon your soul, bind them as a sign upon your arm and let them be frontlets between your eyes. Teach them to your children by talking about them when you sit in your house and walk on the way and when you lie down and when you rise up. You shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates, so that your days and the days of your children may increase upon the soil which the Lord has sworn to your fathers to give to them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

(Numbers XV. 37) Thus spoke the Lord to Moses: Speak to the children of Israel and tell them to make themselves show-fringes upon the corners of their garments throughout their generations and to fasten to the fringe of each corner a thread of skyblue wool. blocks.text: commandments of the Lord and fulfil them. And do not follow your heart and your eyes after which you go astray. Thus may you remember and fulfil all my commandments and be holy unto your God. I am the Lord your God who led you out of the land of Egypt in order to be your God. I am the Lord your God.

אמת All this is truth and faithfulness and it is established unto us that He, the Lord, is our God and there is none beside Him and we are Israel, His people. It is He who frees us from the hand of kings, our King who redeems us from the palm of all oppressors. It is God who requites our enemies on our behalf and pays retribution to all pursuers of our soul. It is He who performs unfathomable deeds of grandeur, wonders without number. He who sets our soul in the course of life and does not allow our feet to falter. He who leads us over the heights of our adversaries and raises our condition above all who hate us. It is He who effects wonders for us and revenge on Pharaoh, signs and miracles in the land of the sons of Ham, who slays all the first-born of Egypt in His wrath and leads His people Israel from their midst to eternal freedom. It is He who causes His children to pass between the divisions of the Red Sea, their persecutors and their enemies did He drown in the depths. His children saw His strength, they praised and acknowledged His Name, they willingly accepted His dominion over them. Moses and the children of Israel answered in song to Thee with great rejoicing and they all said:
מי Who is like Thee among the mighty, O Lord? Who is like Thee, glorious in holiness, awe-inspiring in fame, worker of wonder?
מלכותך Thy children saw Thy kingdom when Thou didst divide the sea before Moses: this is my God, they answered and said: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.
ונאמר And it is said: For the Lord has freed Jacob and redeemed him from the hand of one stronger than he. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who has redeemed Israel.
